typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		VIRTUAL_WF_GUID as string,
		VIRTUAL_HOST_NAME as string,
		VIRTUAL_HOST_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		PHYSICAL_HOST_WF_GUID as string,
		PHYSICAL_HOST_NAME as string,
		PHYSICAL_HOST_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		PHYSICAL_HOST_CPUS as string,
		PHYSICAL_HOST_CORES as string,
		CLUSTER_WF_GUID as string,
		CLUSTER_NAME as string,
		CLUSTER_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		CLUSTER_STATUS as string,
		RELATIONSHIP_DATE as timestamp,
		CLUSTER_CPUS as string,
		CLUSTER_CORES as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		cluster_name as string,
		cluster_sys_class_name as string,
		physical_host_cpus as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		cluster_wf_guid as string,
		physical_host_sys_class_name as string,
		cluster_cores as string,
		physical_host_wf_guid as string,
		todsh_business_effective_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		virtual_host_name as string,
		cluster_status as string,
		physical_host_name as string,
		virtual_host_sys_class_name as string,
		relationship_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		virtual_wf_guid as string,
		cluster_cpus as string,
		physical_host_cores as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		cluster_name = CLUSTER_NAME,
		cluster_sys_class_name = CLUSTER_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		physical_host_cpus = PHYSICAL_HOST_CPUS,
		importdate,
		cluster_wf_guid = CLUSTER_WF_GUID,
		physical_host_sys_class_name = PHYSICAL_HOST_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		cluster_cores = CLUSTER_CORES,
		physical_host_wf_guid = PHYSICAL_HOST_WF_GUID,
		todsh_business_effective_date = TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		virtual_host_name = VIRTUAL_HOST_NAME,
		cluster_status = CLUSTER_STATUS,
		physical_host_name = PHYSICAL_HOST_NAME,
		virtual_host_sys_class_name = VIRTUAL_HOST_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		relationship_date = RELATIONSHIP_DATE,
		virtual_wf_guid = VIRTUAL_WF_GUID,
		cluster_cpus = CLUSTER_CPUS,
		physical_host_cores = PHYSICAL_HOST_CORES),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
